notes: Corrected s004/s005: the accepted alignment gave until they were to ἕως and only over against to πρός. Rules 53, 62 and 68 decide a supplied verb by what is left in the clause to carry it, and what is left here is the expressed prepositional predicate πρὸς Βηθανίαν, not the subordinator; rule 53 names giving such a copula to the word the ASV writes it next to as the recurring failure.
The head stays on over rather than on the supplied were, as rule 62 requires for a preposition carrier.
